Sends authentication via custom header (X-API-Key)

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::scrape;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"auth\":{\"name\":\"X-API-Key\",\"type\":\"header\",\"value\":\"sk-test-key-12345\"},\"respect_robots_txt\":false}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = scrape(&engine, &url).await;
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
